prompt: Mass Effect 2 once won the D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year. Who was the director for the game that won the same award twelve years earlier?
answer: The game was **The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time**, winner of the 2nd Annual D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year in 1999. Its director was **Shigeru Miyamoto**.
